fields.summary_ko.0: Advantest Corporation (ISIN JP3122400009) scheduled to announce FY2026 Q2 earnings on October 28 at 3:30 PM (Japan Standard Time), trading at EUR 176.56 on October 26
fields.summary_ko.1: Q1 revenue JPY 367.5B (39.3% increase year-over-year), operating income JPY 190.0B (53.3% increase year-over-year), operating margin 51.7% with profit growth outpacing revenue growth; full-year revenue raised to JPY 1,714B, operating income raised to JPY 846.0B
